description: This file defines the PerformanceReviewSaveController class, which manages rendering logic for performance review forms, dynamically choosing between 'edit-review' and 'add-review' components based on request parameters.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewSaveController
classes.description: Controller for handling the save operation of performance reviews, extending a Vue-based abstract controller.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component ('edit-review' or 'add-review') based on whether a review ID is present in the request attributes.
